Title: How to Process Betrayal, Dishonesty or In-Law Interference in Marriage Without Losing Your Peace
Description: Forced, premature forgiveness ('Adjust kar lo for the family') buries trauma deeper. Star of Bethlehem, Holly, and Willow heal the shock first so you can decide with clarity. ✦ Vedic Kundli Insight: Rahu or Mangal afflicting the 7th House (Kalatra Bhava) and 8th House. ✿ Natural Pushpa Upaya (Bach Flower Remedy): Star of Bethlehem (heals the deep shock of betrayal), Holly (processes acute heartbreak and anger), and Willow (prevents lifelong bitterness). #VedicAstrology #Kundli #BachFlowerRemedies #MarriageSynastry #SOMA38
